subject: Missing attachment
text: Hey, quick favor—could you resend the budget spreadsheet from this morning? I think the email came through without the actual attachment, or maybe it got clipped on my side. We’re still waiting on it before the client call, so any chance you could drop it in the project folder right now? I can check it quickly and send notes before the meeting. Sorry to be pushy, but this one is holding up the rest of my draft. Let me know if you want me to open a placeholder for now. If I missed it, no worries. Thanks! Talk soon.
